title: Bound ordinary task-sync recovery inventories to pending work
outcome: Ordinary sync recovery avoids repeated unbounded scans of accounted fetch/commit retention and captures only the selected changed planning.
acceptance: Accounted fetch and command-commit retention is keyed or safely retired so ordinary receive/recovery does not enumerate the entire historical inventory and cannot reach a permanent 100000-entry refusal solely from accounted history.

Ordinary sync reuses selected state/captures rather than repeatedly loading the full exchange ledger and native planning for each receive phase; tests demonstrate behavior across accumulated accounted history while preserving uncertain/pending replay.
